Halloween2020Badge.png|{{Color|Spooky|Spooky}} skin on the Halloween 2020 [[Badges|badge]]. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The original ''Knife Throw'' ability replaced the chainsaw that the '''Slasher''' (then called the '''Shredder''') held at Level 5 with dual knives (making it exactly the same as the Level 4 upgrade). *The '''Slasher''' will often throw its knife into the air and then catch it mid air, if it is not attacking any enemies. *All '''Slasher''' skins have their eyes change color at Level 2. However, these eyes were not changed in the [[v1.2.0|Duck Hunt Update]] to fit on the new face of the '''Slasher''', making it look like the '''Slasher''' gains an additional pair of eyes instead. *The {{Color|Spooky|Spooky}} skin was based on the old design of the '''Slasher'''. *The Default skin was loosely based on [[w:c:metalgear:Big Boss|Big Boss]] from the ''Metal Gear'' series. *The {{Color|EventMission|Jason}} skin is based on [[wp:Jason Voorhees|Jason Voorhees]] from the ''Friday the 13th'' series. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The knife wielded by the Default skin at all levels is {{RLinkC|121946387|Bombo's Survival Knife}} gear from the Roblox catalog. *The sword wielded by the {{Color|Shamrock|Spring Time}} skin at all levels is {{RLinkC|431038614|Sword of Glowing-Hope}} gear from the Roblox catalog. *The bandana on the {{Color|Spooky|Spooky}} skin is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|64560336|Jack O' Bandit}} accessory from Roblox catalog. *The hood used by the Level 4 Default and {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} skins is the {{RLinkC|74225426|Hood of the Lonely Raven}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Slasher]].
